extraction.Name: John Douville
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 3, 1918, by the Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Charles J. Montgomery for $1383.00 on March 27, 1918; mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $2000 on April 2, 1918; again mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $100 on June 27, 1918; conveyed by deed to Edward McHenry for $10500 on April 1, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612801 issued; Southeast quarter section 20, township 96, north of range 75; receipt for the patent signed by the allottee February 14, 1918; Douville and wife were parties to the mortgage and conveyance transactions
